text: Original design rationale (from the 2026-09-06 pre-implementation plan, now deleted): Stavrobot reaches iMCP through a host-side authenticated HTTP bridge in the logged-in macOS session, mirroring the existing Reminders bridge, because imcp-server is a macOS binary that cannot run inside the Linux plugin-runner container and iMCP's native framework integrations should not be duplicated. A small domain-specific HTTP API was preferred over a general HTTP MCP gateway, since a gateway alone would not make Stavrobot an MCP client (revisit if plugin-runner's add-mcp support is to be used instead). The supported bundled imcp-server stdio command was preferred over implementing iMCP's internal Bonjour transport; the canonical repo briefly ran the Bonjour transport until the stdio port on 2026-11-11. The plan also said not to assume every iMCP service should be exposed: services and read/write operations are to be opted into explicitly.
author: Diego Petrucci <baulei@icloud.com>
